$comment: workflow-kit's openrouter node strategy imports llm_kit, the katsoft-llm-kit[config,sdk] package installed in workflow-kit's own venv from pyproject.toml (>=1.1,<2), not a shared-lib link (REQUIRED: the node dispatches its model declaration through llm_kit.dispatch.declaration.run, and a schema-typed artifact is checked with llm_kit.completion.contract.OutputContract and llm_kit.schema.json_schema). The plugin edge to llm-kit stays so the owning plugin (its account CLI and key provisioning) is installed rather than assumed present; an absent llm_kit is refused at the node runner, the artifact checker and the compiler's schema check, and the package pin guarantees the API, so no too-old probe remains. bootstrap_lib is REQUIRED too: the loader validates every model: declaration with bootstrap_lib.model_declaration.parse and CORE_IDS, first shipped in bootstrap 0.129.0. Every compiled openrouter node records execution events: scripts/openrouter_run.py --events calls bootstrap_lib.execution_event.Emitter and JsonlSink(mode="truncate"), first shipped in bootstrap 0.135.0. A node that provides a typed artifact also records its contract event: scripts/openrouter_run.py --provides --events and scripts/check_artifact.py --events call bootstrap_lib.execution_event.Emitter(..., schema="plugins-kit.execution-event/v3"), first shipped in bootstrap 0.137.0. An agent step's model: accepts {id, effort} entries through bootstrap_lib.model_declaration.parse_entries and EFFORT_LEVELS, first shipped in bootstrap 0.150.0. requires_bootstrap is 0.160.0, the first bootstrap that revokes undeclared bootstrap-written .pth links and stamps released-package targets in the venv check, which a venv holding a package-installed llm_kit relies on.
